title: HealthInformatics EDTriageModelLaunch

stats.done_summary:
Completed the TriageAssist-B evaluation report. Deliverables:

**Analysis code** (`code/analysis.py`): Loads both CSV datasets, annotates clinical direction of 'better' for each metric, runs two-proportion z-tests for online pilot metrics, and generates 5 publication-quality figures.

**Figures** (5 PNG files in `report/images/`):
- fig1_offline_metrics.png — Grouped bar chart of offline performance and calibration metrics
- fig2_online_metrics.png — Grouped bar chart of online pilot operational metrics with significance stars
- fig3_relative_changes.png — Waterfall/horizontal bar chart of relative changes (green=improvement, red=regression)
- fig4_scorecard.png — Comprehensive color-coded scorecard table of all 10 metrics
- fig5_radar.png — Radar/spider chart of normalized offline metrics

**Report** (`report/report.md`): Full academic-style report including executive summary, methods, results with figure references, discussion (sensitivity-calibration trade-off, time-to-physician paradox, clinician trust failure mode, patient safety), limitations, and actionable recommendations.

**Key finding**: TriageAssist-B improves on 3/10 metrics (sensitivity +7.3%, AUROC +3.7%, time-to-physician −14.8%) but regresses on 7/10, including statistically significant increases in LWBS rate (+64.9%, p=0.030) and clinician override rate (+69.8%, p<0.001), plus severe calibration degradation (+49.4%). Recommendation: Do not expand TriageAssist-B; pursue recalibration and re-pilot.
